video.subtitle: Doc system prompt cua ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor de hoc cach AI product duoc dieu khien.
sourceBlocks: Repo GitHub asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks document system prompt instructions cho nhieu AI chatbot va AI product.
Gia tri khong chi nam o prompt mau, ma nam o cach product gan vai tro, gioi han hanh vi, dung tool, memory, guardrail va workflow agent.
Video nay dung repo nhu content truth, banner nhu style reference, khong embed anh hay logo ben thu ba.
